sdfGenerator.title: Face Shadow SDF Generator
sdfGenerator.copy: `Face Shadow SDF Generator` is a standalone desktop application for generating stylized shadow maps from `FBX` meshes. It uses Blender for extraction, supports both single-mesh and multi-mesh targets, and keeps preview, correction, and export in one workflow. Current version: `1.3.2`.

cards.title: Mesh-aware baking
cards.body: Generation is driven by the actual mesh shape, UV data, and the current 3D view direction, not by a flat image-only workflow.

cards.title: Manual correction
cards.body: The workflow includes `UV Select`, `Dark Shadow`, `Light Accent`, `Erase Feature Paint`, and mirrored paint transfer for fast cleanup.

cards.title: Composite targets
cards.body: Multiple meshes can be selected together when one working UV target is split across several mesh objects.

cards.title: Seam-safe export
cards.body: Version `1.3.2` improves positive UV padding so exported maps avoid black seam growth around UV borders.

meta.body: This tool is built for stylized face-shadow workflows, but the pipeline itself is not limited to face-only assets. Any `FBX` mesh with usable UVs can move through the same preview, bake, correction, and export flow.

image.caption: Main workspace view. The landscape layout keeps the 3D preview, UV work area, and output inspection in one connected flow.

sections.title: Current capabilities
items: `UV Map` selection by UV layer or material split
Positive and negative UV padding control

sections.title: Requirements
items: Python environment for source launch and development
An `FBX` file with valid mesh and UV data

sections.title: Quick start
items: Set the Blender path if auto-detection fails.
Select one mesh, or select multiple meshes if the working target is split across several objects.
Rotate the 3D preview to the intended working direction.
If needed, switch to `UV Select` and choose only specific UV islands.
If needed, paint manual `Dark Shadow` or `Light Accent` detail.

entries.title: Left panel
entries.body: Blender path, `FBX` loader, mesh list, `UV Map` selector, version label, and language selector.

entries.title: Center panel
entries.body: 3D preview, UV select / paint workspace, and output preview modes.

entries.title: Right panel
entries.body: UV selection tools, brush tools, UV display tools, lighting presets, bake and output settings, layer settings, and export controls.

entries.title: Single mesh
entries.body: If the target lives in one mesh, select that mesh and choose the correct UV option.

entries.title: Multi-mesh
entries.body: If one working target is split across multiple mesh objects, select them together. The app combines compatible selections into one internal composite mesh for preview, baking, UV masking, and export.

entries.title: UV Map options
entries.body: The `UV Map` dropdown can expose more than one option for one mesh. This usually comes from multiple UV layers or from material-based splits on overlapping UV layouts.

entries.title: `main.png`
entries.body: Primary baked result.

entries.title: `flipped.png`
entries.body: Opposite-light rebake. This is not a simple horizontal flip.

entries.title: `rg.png`
entries.body: Packed output where `R = main`, `G = flipped`, `B` is unused, and `A` stores UV alpha when transparent export is enabled.

entries.title: `mask.png`
entries.body: Working and export mask.

entries.title: `asym.png`
entries.body: Derived output based on `main` and `flipped`.

entries.title: `Blender path` / `FBX file` / `Load FBX`
entries.body: These controls define the Blender executable used for headless extraction, the current `FBX`, and the load action that extracts mesh, UV, and material-based UV options.

entries.title: `Mesh list` / `UV Map`
entries.body: The mesh list shows all imported meshes sorted A-Z. Multi-selection is used when one working target is split across several mesh objects. `UV Map` chooses the active UV option for the current mesh or selected mesh group.

entries.title: `UV Selection`
entries.body: `Select All UV` selects every visible UV island. `Clear UV Selection` clears the current selection. `Use selected UV islands` restricts generation to the selected islands only.

entries.title: `Manual Feature Brush`
entries.body: Includes `Select UV Islands`, `Place Dark Shadow`, `Place Light Accent`, and `Erase Feature Paint`. `Brush size %` is the unified brush size. `Mirror Feature Paint` copies paint across the UV X axis, and `Clear Feature Paint` removes all manual paint.

entries.title: `Bake / Output`
entries.body: `Resolution` supports `512`, `1K`, `2K`, `4K`, `8K`, and `16K`. The panel also exposes `Bake contrast`, `Bake ambient`, `Light X / Y / Z`, `Bake smoothing`, `UV edge padding`, `Feature strength`, `Feature blur`, `Transparent outside UV`, `Anime feature shadows`, `Use current 3D view`, and `Reset 3D View`.

entries.title: `Advanced Layers`
entries.body: `Layer count`, `Growth intensity`, `Horizontal growth`, `Vertical growth`, `Blend mode`, and `SDF radius` control intermediate generated layers and final blending behavior.

entries.title: 3D preview
entries.body: Drag to rotate the mesh. Use `Use current 3D view` when the current orientation should drive the bake.

entries.title: UV Select
entries.body: Mouse wheel zooms, middle drag pans, left click selects islands, `Ctrl + Left click` adds or removes islands from the selection, left drag paints, and right drag erases.

sections.title: Known limitations
items: Manual feature paint is a UV-space assist pass, not a full 3D-aware sculpting system.
Some `FBX` files expose overlapping work regions through materials rather than true separate UV layers.
Seam-heavy UV layouts may still require negative padding and manual cleanup depending on the source asset.

entries.body:
Fixed positive UV padding so exported maps do not grow black seam lines around UV islands.
Expanded output alpha together with positive padding so padded edge bleed remains visible in transparent exports.
Repaired the immediate UV border ring before positive padding so damaged border pixels are not copied outward.

Fixed manual brush size scaling so small values produce visibly thinner strokes.
Replaced separate brush width and height controls with one unified brush size control.
Removed feature blur influence from UV paint preview.
Fixed UV wire rendering below `1.0`.
Improved thin UV wire visibility through subpixel rendering.

Added multi-mesh target selection for UV targets split across several mesh objects.
Added internal composite mesh generation for preview and baking.
Blocked multi-mesh generation when selected meshes do not share a compatible UV option.
Updated 3D preview and UV selection to work with the combined target mesh.

Added property tooltips on the right panel.
Added English, Korean, and Japanese UI switching.
Added resolution-consistent manual feature blur behavior.
Restored the legacy default feature blur strength.

Added UV map selection for meshes with multiple UV layers.
Added material-split UV options for overlapping UV layouts.
Added version display in the left panel.

Added standalone desktop UI with Blender integration.
Added GPU-based 3D preview and view-based baking workflow.
Added UV island selection, manual feature paint, mirror paint, and erase.
Added `main`, `flipped`, `rg`, `mask`, and `asym` export flow.

Initial release.
Added deterministic rule-based shadow generation pipeline.
Added basic Blender-based `FBX` loading and UV mask export flow.
